## Summary
A clear, one- or two-sentence description of the bug.

## Severity / Impact
How badly does this affect you or others? (e.g. blocks all usage, workaround exists, minor annoyance, cosmetic only)

## Screenshots (if applicable)
Add screenshots if the bug is visual or easier to show than describe. Delete this section if not relevant.

## Possible Cause (optional)
If you've already dug into it, share any leads on what might be causing this — a specific file, function, or recent change you suspect.

## Additional Context
Anything else that might help — related issues, when it started happening, whether it's consistent or intermittent.

## Checklist
- [ ] I searched existing Issues and Discussions and didn't find a duplicate
